description: This file contains classes and functions related to database configuration management and database backup operations in a CRM system, including handling of language strings for error reporting.

classes.name: DatabaseConfig
classes.description: Manages database connection configurations including credentials, host data, and database type. Provides static methods to instantiate configurations from files or other config objects.

classes.name: DatabaseBackup
classes.description: Handles the process of backing up database data by iterating through source data and storing it into a target, with support for skipping certain stages and localizing language strings.

methods.name: DatabaseConfig::__construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing database connection parameters such as host, username, password, database name, and type.

methods.name: DatabaseConfig::getInstanceFromConfigFile
methods.description: Creates a new DatabaseConfig instance based on parameters loaded from the 'config.inc.php' configuration file.

methods.name: DatabaseConfig::getInstanceFromOtherConfig
methods.description: Creates a new DatabaseConfig instance using another existing DatabaseConfig object.

methods.name: DatabaseBackup::__construct
methods.description: Constructor sets source, target, and optional skip stages for the database backup process.

methods.name: DatabaseBackup::backup
methods.description: Executes the backup operation by iterating over the source data and transferring it to the target, respecting the skip stages.

methods.name: getLanguageStrings
methods.description: Returns language-specific strings used for error messages and status updates in the backup process.
